target_customer: Frontier robotics and humanoid labs that buy training data
problem: Humanoid robot models need diverse real world human movement data, while factory datasets repeat the same tasks in the same places.
business_model: data sales to robotics labs; paid contributors and partner businesses record tasks with Asimov collection kits

founders.name: Lyem Ningthou
prior_employers: United States Air Force (built data pipelines, per YC launch post)
previous_startups: Unnamed startup that grew to six figure revenue, per YC page
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a defense tech robotics researcher. The founders met as college roommates; no school named.

founders.name: Anshul Verma
prior_employers: Scale AI (data infrastructure, per YC launch post)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Anshul with no surname; the surname comes from a search summary and is unverified.

competitors.name: Xsens and Vicon motion capture
competitors.what: traditional lab based motion capture, named as the costly alternative

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs custom wearable capture hardware, annotation tooling for 3D pose and depth, and a distributed contributor operation, but no research breakthrough.

defensibility.rationale: Data collection is operational and several startups were entering egocentric data in 2026; a data asset and partner network may compound but are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too recent to know; as of 2026-11 no acquisition or shutdown found.

market_need_then: Robotics labs were seeking egocentric human video at scale in 2026, with NVIDIA research using tens of thousands of hours of human video.

identity.voice_and_tone: tagline Human intelligence for robotics; privacy focused guidance

brand_strength.rationale: Early stage; a sourced issue is name collision with Menlo Research's Asimov humanoid robot, which coverage had to disambiguate.

outcome_analysis: Asimov is an early stage W26 company selling human movement data to robotics labs, with a creative side business running a cleaning company whose cleaners wear its kits. It has YC, Robinhood Ventures and angel backing, no disclosed round size, and no outcome yet, so any forecast rests on a hot physical AI data market with growing competition.
